subject: DISPLAY statement
notes:
READ the whole dispatch, both arms: EmitDisplay's last line is ctx.Writer.Line(d.NoAdvancing ? $"{sink}.Write({image});" : $"{sink}.WriteLine({image});"). The phrase-NOT-specified arm is WriteLine, whose platform line terminator is exactly GR10's 'reset to the leftmost position of the next line of the device'. The arm selector is faithful to the phrase: AcceptDisplayBinder.BindDisplay sets NoAdvancing = 'display.displayNoAdvancing() is not null', one-for-one with the optional grammar sub-rule, so absence of the phrase can only take the WriteLine arm. BOTH sinks are covered identically -- 'string sink = d.ToStdErr ? "System.Console.Error" : "System.Console"' is chosen before the terminator decision, so the SYSERR route resets the line the same way (checked because feedback_two_arm_dispatch is the repeat defect shape here; the sink axis and the advancing axis are independent and both were read). B-SYSOUT
C-CONSOLE' (each statement reset the position to the next line), and the golden comp5_display_beyond_picture.out carries two lines produced by two DISPLAY statements.
